universal_checks.question: Does the asset match current canonical entity/system data?
Is the gameplay subject readable at intended mobile combat scale?
Does visual design support rather than obscure gameplay function?
Were at least three references transformed rather than copied?
Does the asset remain legible in the phone crop?
Does PC detail avoid revealing additional gameplay information?

character_or_creature: lost limb/adaptation continuity planned when applicable
recruited creature remains same individual/species visually
boss: phase differences are not simple recolors
future phase is not exposed through player-facing Archives
remanence: mark can be traced to a lived event
same-species individuals can remain visually distinct
ui: touch target at least 48 pt where interactive
knowledge state not encoded by color alone
environment: extraction or route cue remains readable when relevant
persistent corpses/traces have safe visual zones
decoration can be reduced without losing identity
vfx: final density waits for PC playtest

stop_conditions: enemy or hero loses silhouette identity at mobile scale
remanence looks like an unrelated new species
PC presentation reveals information unavailable on mobile
asset requires a gameplay rule not present in canon
preproduction_rule: PASS means ready for next art-production stage, not approved for gameplay merge
